Docs list infrastructure providers for Robinhood Chain: Alchemy (recommended), Chainstack, QuickNode, Blockdaemon, dRPC, Validation Cloud and GlobalStake; public RPC/feeds are rate-limited and not for production.

Docs: Robinhood Chain uses BoLD dispute resolution with a permissioned validator set; running a validator requires allowlist inclusion and a 1 WETH bond. Full node hardware: 8+ cores, 64 GB RAM (128 GB recommended), several TB NVMe.

Docs full-node guide: mainnet node uses offchainlabs/nitro-node:v3.11.2-3599aca; a delayed backup feed wss://delayed-feed.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com runs ~500ms behind the primary feed; the public feed is best-effort with no uptime guarantee.
HN: BlockRazor posted "Show HN" (2026-09-22) of a lower-latency sequencer feed for Robinhood Chain; HN story 49799239 has 1 point, 0 comments.
